description: React component for displaying a match summary including events, lineups, and heat map with dynamic data loading and mock fallback.

methods.name: generateEventsFromMatch
methods.description: Generates a list of match events such as goals, cards, and substitutions based on match data and highlights.

methods.name: getRandomPlayer
methods.description: Returns a random player name from predefined lists based on team and position.

methods.name: getGoalDescription
methods.description: Provides a random description for a goal event.

methods.name: getMockEvents
methods.description: Returns a static list of mock match events for fallback display.

methods.name: getEventIcon
methods.description: Returns an emoji icon representing the event type.

methods.name: getEventColor
methods.description: Determines the color gradient class based on event impact and type.
